svg.aria-label: How carrydown works: ground truth is required, project constraints (people and target) are optional; the agent takes what you have into the plan and specs, then GitHub issues, project board and developer skill
svg.text: Planning decisions stay with people. The skills set up, draft to templates, validate and populate.
People: how many, which track each owns,
percent of their time, start dates and days off
Target: a delivery date or a number of weeks,
plus any breaks on the calendar
section index every later file cites
the agent takes what you have
Give both and the plan fits them.
Give one and the agent backs into the other.
one specification per work item, checked against the plan
labels, sub-epics, work item issues, sub-issue links,
Epic roll-up comment. Dry run first, then apply.
Work unit, Track, Complete by, Checkpoint,
agentic editor; a developer says "work on WI-07"
the ground truth carries down into every spec
and fields on the plan, the issues
Every file is a dry run until you say yes. Nothing is written to GitHub without a confirmation.
